Budget 2027 raised your tax relief to twelve thousand ringgit. No, you're not getting twelve thousand back.
Tax relief doesn't cut your tax. It cuts the income you pay tax on.
Say your taxable income sits in the three percent band. The extra three thousand ringgit of relief comes off that income first.
Three percent of three thousand? That's a saving of about ninety ringgit a year.
Earn more, save more. In the eleven percent band, about three hundred and thirty. In the new eighteen percent band, about five hundred and forty.
Same with those running shoes. A thousand ringgit of eligible spending saves you a thousand times your tax rate, not a thousand ringgit.
So relief does help. Just a lot less than the headline makes it sound.
